brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells (piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full) each with a full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) provide two compartments for utensils.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; parts are 3D-printed plastic whose water-tightness depends on material, print settings and sealing which cannot be verified. Shape provides bins but no waterproof guarantee.
Dishwasher safety depends on chosen filament's heat/food-safety rating and washing conditions. The system explicitly states it knows nothing about materials, heat resistance or food safety.

finish.summary: Built a two-cell holder with two full-depth bins. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe cannot be verified as built, as they are material/process claims outside the configurator's scope.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
